name: weather_and_campsite_germany
description: The dataset includes several weather parameter and and information about campsite utilisation in germany. The data is available on a montly basis and separated by the german bundeslander. The data starts Jan 2002 and lasts until May 2024. The few german column names can be translated easily. The datasets used are from Deutscher Wetterdienst and Statistische Bundesamt
creator: Ronja Schwarz
